Enriched to 25 tweets across 7 users with comments and retweets.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: authenticate_twitter
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates a user by username and password and, on success, starts an authenticated session used by the other TwitterAPI tools. Returns a confirmation that the session is active for the authenticated user. Refuses requests with missing/empty credentials, unknown usernames, or incorrect passwords, and will not authenticate a different user while another session is already active.

tool_schemas.name: comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment from the currently authenticated user on the specified tweet and returns the created comment with its identifying details. Refuses requests when no user is authenticated, when the target tweet_id does not exist, or when comment_content is empty or only whitespace. It also refuses to comment on tweets that are not available in the current working set or are otherwise not in a commentable state.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to comment on.

tool_schemas.name: follow_user
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified user to the authenticated user’s following list and returns the updated follow relationship. Refuses requests when no user is authenticated, when username_to_follow is missing/empty or does not correspond to an existing user, or when the authenticated user attempts to follow themselves. It also refuses the request if the authenticated user already follows the target user.

username_to_follow.description: Username of the user to follow.

tool_schemas.name: get_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the tweet matching the provided tweet_id, including its stored metadata in the service’s working set. Refuses requests when tweet_id is missing/invalid or when no tweet with that ID exists. It also refuses access if the tweet is not available in the current working set for retrieval.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_tweet_comments
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of comments associated with the specified tweet_id. Refuses requests when tweet_id is missing/invalid or when the tweet does not exist. It also refuses the request if the tweet is not available in the current working set for comment lookup.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to retrieve comments for.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns basic statistics for the specified username, such as counts derived from the service’s local working set (for example tweets and follow relationships tracked by the integration). Refuses requests when username is missing/empty or does not correspond to a known user. It also refuses if the user is not available in the current working set for stats computation.

username.description: Username of the user to get statistics for.

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0546000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0546000") else "/app/database")
def get_user_stats(username):
    import json, os, math, random
    _S = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'state.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    tweets = _S.get("tweets", {})
    tweet_count = len([t for t in tweets.values() if t.get("username") == username])
    following_count = len(_S.get("following_list", [])) if username == _S.get("username") else 0
    retweet_count = len(_S.get("retweets", {}).get(username, []))
    return {"tweet_count": tweet_count, "following_count": following_count, "retweet_count": retweet_count}

tool_schemas.name: get_user_tweets
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns all tweets authored by the specified username that are present in the service’s working set. Refuses requests when username is missing/empty or does not correspond to a known user. It also refuses if the user’s tweets are not available in the current working set for listing.

username.description: Username of the user whose tweets to retrieve.

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0546000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0546000") else "/app/database")
def get_user_tweets(username):
    import json, os, math, random
    _S = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, 'state.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    return [t for t in _S.get("tweets", {}).values() if t.get("username") == username]

tool_schemas.name: list_all_following
tool_schemas.description: Lists and returns all users the currently authenticated user is following. Refuses requests when no user is authenticated. It may also refuse if the authenticated user is not available in the current working set for follow listing.

tool_schemas.name: mention
tool_schemas.description: Adds the provided mentioned_usernames as mentions on the specified tweet and returns the updated tweet (or its updated mention list). Refuses requests when no user is authenticated, when the tweet_id does not exist, or when mentioned_usernames is empty or contains empty values. It also refuses mentions for usernames that do not exist, and refuses updates when the tweet is not available in the current working set or cannot be modified.

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet where users are mentioned.

mentioned_usernames.description: List of usernames to be mentioned.

tool_schemas.name: post_tweet
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new tweet authored by the currently authenticated user and returns the created tweet with its assigned identifier and stored fields. Refuses requests when no user is authenticated or when content is empty or only whitespace. It also refuses tags that are not formatted as hashtags (must start with '#') and mentions that are not formatted as @-mentions (must start with '@'), and may refuse if referenced users are not available in the current working set.

tags.description: List of tags for the tweet. Tag name should start with #. This is only relevant if the user wants to add tags to the tweet.

mentions.description: List of users mentioned in the tweet. Mention name should start with @. This is only relevant if the user wants to add mentions to the tweet.

tool_schemas.name: posting_get_login_status
tool_schemas.description: Returns whether there is an authenticated session currently active, and, when logged in, identifies the current user for this session. It refuses requests only when the session state cannot be read or has been invalidated, in which case it reports that no valid login context is available.

tool_schemas.name: retweet
tool_schemas.description: Retweets the specified tweet as the authenticated user and returns the resulting retweet/interaction state for that tweet. It refuses requests when no user is logged in, when the tweet_id is missing or not a valid integer identifier, when the target tweet cannot be found, or when the user is not allowed to retweet it. It also refuses the request if the tweet has already been retweeted by the authenticated user or if the tweet’s state prevents retweeting (for example, deleted).

tweet_id.description: ID of the tweet to retweet.

tool_schemas.name: search_tweets
tool_schemas.description: Searches the service’s accessible tweet set for tweets whose content matches the provided keyword and returns the matching tweets. It refuses requests when the keyword is missing, empty, or not a string, or when the keyword is too broad to execute under service limits. It may also refuse searches when there is no authenticated session and the service is configured to require login for searching.

keyword.description: Keyword to search for in the content of the tweets.

tool_schemas.name: unfollow_user
tool_schemas.description: Stops the authenticated user from following the specified username and returns the updated follow relationship status. It refuses requests when no user is logged in, when username_to_unfollow is missing or empty, when the target user does not exist, or when the request attempts to unfollow the current user. It also refuses the request if the authenticated user is not currently following that account or if the relationship cannot be changed due to account state or restrictions.

username_to_unfollow.description: Username of the user to unfollow.

metadata.name: Bluefin Social Console
metadata.description: Provides authenticated microblogging integration with session state and APIs to post, retrieve, search, and interact with posts, replies, mentions, reposts, and follow relationships.
